mapper.select: SELECT post_id AS postId, post_title AS postTitle, post_sub_title AS postSubTitle, post_thumbnail AS postThumbnail, post_tag AS postTag FROM post_tbl WHERE post_tag = #{tag} ORDER BY post_id DESC

SELECT post_id AS postId, post_title AS postTitle, post_sub_title AS postSubTitle, post_thumbnail AS postThumbnail, post_git AS postGit, post_content AS postContent, post_tag AS postTag FROM post_tbl WHERE post_id = #{postId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_tbl ( post_title, post_sub_title, post_git, post_thumbnail, post_tag, post_content ) VALUES ( #{postTitle}, #{postSubTitle}, #{postGit}, #{postThumbnail}, #{postTag}, #{postContent} )
mapper.update: UPDATE post_tbl SET post_title = #{postTitle}, post_sub_title = #{postSubTitle}, post_git = #{postGit}, post_thumbnail = #{postThumbnail}, post_tag = #{postTag}, post_content = #{postContent} WHERE post_id = #{postId}
